# Filmsera

> Filmsera is a shared disposable camera app for iPhone (App Store id 6781880091). A host creates a "film" for an event, guests join by QR code, link or short code and shoot from their own phones (in the app or the browser), and every photo stays hidden until the reveal time the host picks. Then the whole roll appears at once, tagged with who took each shot.

Key facts (updated 2026-11-11):
- Platform: hosts create films in the iPhone app (iOS 17 or later). Guests join from the free iPhone app OR from any phone's browser (iPhone Safari, Android Chrome) with no app and no account: they type a name and shoot. Browser guests take photos only (no video); the 25 live film looks render in the iPhone app. Video clips in a shared film come with the Celebration and Wedding passes.
- Pricing (current App Store version, USD): hosting a film for up to 10 guests (20 if the host has Filmsera Pro) and joining films are free. Guests never pay. Bigger films use a one-time pass per film: Party $7.99 (up to 30 guests), Celebration $24.99 (up to 100, video clips) or Wedding $49.99 (up to 250, video clips); each adds an HD recap without a watermark and keeps photos for 1 year. Keep Photos 1 Year ($4.99) extends a free film's storage. Photos are kept 30 days after the reveal otherwise. Filmsera Pro (subscription): $1.99/week with a 3-day free trial, $5.99/month or $34.99/year; unlocks all 25 cameras, premium look packs and every recap style, and lets the subscriber's free films hold 20 guests.
- Also a personal film camera with 25 looks rendered live in the viewfinder (disposable flash, 35mm, instant, 8mm, VHS, digicam and more). 5 cameras are free.
- Features: timed reveal (host can reveal early), photos tagged by who took them, vertical recap reels with music, Live Activity reveal countdown, Photo Booth four-shot strips, hold the shutter for video.
- No ads, no third-party tracking, no AI training on photos. 21 languages.
